title: A Cellar for the Bell
author: Mara Dunmore
blurb: Lena Pemberton, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
